name: revolved-inset
why: A 10 x 10 section standing 10 mm off the axis, inset by 2 and revolved: a ring of pi * (18^2 - 12^2) * 6 = 3392.920 mm3 by closed form. A revolve's section lies in XZ, so the inset's measure (its areas as a vector, its depths against the outline) must assume no plane; a guard that summed XY read 0 mm2 here and refused every revolve(inset(...)).
